name: mirage
text: Done. The desk had 456 bids resting ($212) and 186 more waiting on my repeat guard, not on money or the wallet limit. So I raised that guard: up to 12 bids/bets per game (was 6) and $4 per side (was $3). Together with the earlier change ($25 a game, 1200% of wallet) the desk can now fill the game with many small, different bids. Quality rules are untouched: at least 2% edge, 3+ agreeing books with a well-known book among them, small 1/16-Kelly stakes, the $5 cap on near-identical bets. I'll read the next digest for how many fills this adds and how the bids do against the closing line, and tighten if quality slips. Revert commands are in research/review/CHANGES.md.
